native_fixed200_retests.random_delay_assignment: one uniform isolated random.Random(13).choice per clip; frozen across the eight retained checkpoints
native_fixed200_retests.delay_application: hold previous full joint target during initial 5 ms physics substeps; simulation continues
native_fixed200_retests.dataset_role: development/regression; repeatedly used for training monitoring and snapshot selection
native_fixed200_retests.data_exposure: no exact clip overlap with the training pool in preparation records; independence of recording sources is not established
native_fixed200_retests.evidence_level: existing per-clip metric records and matching archived summaries; raw per-frame trajectories are not included in the release
native_fixed200_retests.cpu_onnx_relation: FP32 CPU ONNX demonstrations are a separate protocol and do not reproduce these BF16 simulation metrics

metrics.completion: all planned transitions executed without native termination; does not imply precise tracking or physical hardware stability
metrics.normalized_return: equal-clip mean of total_reward / (0.1 * planned_steps); failed tail remains in the denominator
metrics.controlled_joint_mae_deg: equal-clip mean of mean absolute degree error over executed frames and the 23 controlled joints
metrics.controlled_joint_rmse_deg: sqrt(equal-clip mean of mean squared degree error over executed frames and the 23 controlled joints))
metrics.frame_alignment: simulated next state versus next reference frame; terminating frame included; padding and post-done frames excluded
metrics.executed_frame_fraction: sum(executed_frames) / sum(planned_frames); no zero-filled unexecuted tail
metrics.uncertainty: no confidence intervals estimated; repeated evaluations and snapshots are not independent training seeds
metrics.missing_csv_value: empty cell means unavailable/not reported, never zero

historical_panels.precision_note: small historical summaries lack per-task precision readback; not used for FP32/BF16 comparison
historical_panels.evidence_level: archived small summaries and derived historical tables; complete original replay chain is unavailable
historical_panels.targeted18: 4 run/transition plus 12 jump references seen in training, plus 2 diagnostic challenge references
historical_panels.push120: 5 references x 24 fixed conditions; standing plus walk, run, jump A and jump B; not 120 independent motions
historical_panels.push120_controls: matched no-push branch from the same native physical prefix
historical_panels.perturbation: root horizontal velocity increment of 0.5 or 1.0 m/s; 60 conditions at each magnitude; not a force in newtons
historical_panels.standing24: one fixed pose x 4 directions x 3 event times (1, 2.5, 4 s) x 2 magnitudes; subset of push120, not extra independent trials
historical_panels.standing_velocity_settling_confirmation: first post-event time after 25 consecutive valid 50 Hz frames with planar root speed <0.10 m/s and full angular speed norm <0.20 rad/s; includes 0.5 s confirmation window
historical_panels.standing_settling_scope: does not imply return to original position, orientation or pose; dynamic reference recovery times are not claimed

public_files.native_bf16_candidate_snapshots.csv: all eight retained snapshots in the matched random-delay retest batch; not a dense or multi-seed learning curve
public_files.historical_panels_65k.csv: separate historical panels; subset rows must not be added as independent samples
public_files.delay_strata_65k.csv: five strata contain different clips and cannot identify a causal latency effect

source_code_note: the public training tree is a maintained snapshot, not a byte-for-byte archive of every historical evaluation file
release_preparation: these historical aggregates use transcription, deterministic metric checks and plotting only; their native CUDA BF16 evaluations were not rerun; newly recorded CPU FP32 demonstration videos use a separate protocol
